name: Medovik
description: A cake made with honey. Thin sheets of honeyed dough are baked, then stacked layer by layer with sour cream frosting spread between each sheet. The cake is finished with a sprinkle of crumbs and a drizzle of honey syrup. Every step must be done carefully to produce a neat, even result.

suspicious.name: Suspicious Medovik
suspicious.description: A cake made with honey. Any trace of sweetness has been incinerated into a bitter, burnt mess by a roaring oven fire. Though the sour cream frosting fulfills its tangy duty perfectly, it stands entirely unsupported without any sweetness to answer its call...
suspicious.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.

delicious.name: Delicious Medovik
delicious.description: A cake made with honey. Amber pastry and snow-white cream embrace each other layer after layer in perfect harmony. Looking at it is like turning the pages of a chronicle, each one revealing a narrative equally brilliant and enchanting.
delicious.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.
